task_type: production cache booking and release provenance incident
requested_outcome: Identify and repair the production incident so event and vacation discovery use durable last-known results, online booking remains usable, trail detail pages expose all approved nearby-content groups, and the exact tested release is the one served publicly.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co event rails, vacation online flow and trail detail pages
authorization_boundary: Diagnose production read-only, implement and verify a release candidate. Do not place a real booking or overwrite production until the active publication boundary is confirmed.

lesson_bundle.reason: The incident spans accepted VII cache, trail and release decisions.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Use the VII master plan and feedback standard as the product contract and verify the whole affected family.

lesson_bundle.reason: A local code fix cannot prove the public booking and discovery journeys are restored.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Open the exact candidate and public release, exercise cold load, retry, dated and undated flows, and inspect desktop and mobile.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user suspects a version mix-up.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Record immutable commit, version and deployment identities and prove which code serves localhost and production.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A cold event page still replaces usable cached places with a temporary supplier error.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Move visitor discovery to durable read-only snapshots and warm the required keys independently of visits.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Cold-load event rails during an injected refresh failure and still render the last accepted real places.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Undated online places appear, but the dated quote or booking handoff fails.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Trace one exact room through cached capability, dated quote, detail and checkout without submitting an order.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The same site and room reach a booking-ready checkout after authoritative validation.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only one trail happens to show nearby sections while other trail pages omit them.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inventory every public trail slug and require the four approved content families or a truthful empty-state policy.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All representative trail regions render vacation, spa, attractions and suppliers with working links.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The tested local code is not the code served publicly.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Bind build, version, deployment and public asset evidence to one immutable commit.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The deployed release identity and visible behavior match the tested commit; localhost provenance is separately identified.

affected_family: dated vacation quote and booking handoff

midpoint_gate.trigger: After identifying the exact public and localhost versions and tracing cache reads and scheduled writes to their runtime databases.
checks: Prove whether scheduled warming and visitor reads use the same database and key policy.
Prove whether the missing trail sections are route-data variation or stale-version evidence.
Exercise one online-capable vacation through quote and checkout without submission.

attack_questions: What happens on a cold browser when the supplier is temporarily unavailable?
What happens after date rollover before the first visitor?
Can the room identity disappear between the online card and checkout?
Do all trail pages, not only the sampled one, expose the approved nearby families?
Can another deployment or stale local server make the verification evidence false?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public URLs opened on desktop and mobile with immutable release identity and network evidence.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Focused tests, production-safe API traces, schedule and database provenance, full trail inventory and independent release review.

effectiveness.baseline: Production returned a stale event snapshot, a current vacation home-deals key returned 503, and the user observed missing trail sections in the open local page.
effectiveness.target: No visitor-triggered supplier dependency for discovery, a verified booking handoff, complete trail reverse links and one provable release source.
